Access and manage design projects, screens, components, and styleguides in Zeplin. Retrieve design specs, assets, code snippets, and design tokens. Create and manage notes and comments on screens. Publish screen versions with PNG/JPEG images. Manage design tokens including colors, text styles, and spacing tokens at project and styleguide levels. Access flow boards, variable collections, and connected components. Invite and remove project and styleguide members. Manage organization members and workspace settings. Receive webhooks for changes to projects, screens, components, notes, styleguides, and organization membership.

Validate email addresses for deliverability, detecting invalid, catch-all, spam trap, abuse, and disposable emails. Score email quality using AI to assess subscriber engagement likelihood. Find business email addresses by name and domain. Search domains for email format patterns. Check email activity data (opens, clicks, forwards, unsubscribes) to identify active inboxes. Upload and process bulk email lists for validation and scoring. Evaluate email list health with estimated bounce rates. Retrieve WHOIS and website availability information for domains. Manage allowlists and blocklists for custom validation filtering. Check account credit balance and API usage statistics.

Manage CRM data and send multichannel messages via WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, and Email. Create, read, update, and delete collection records, list entries, and custom attributes. Send WhatsApp template and direct messages, SMS (transactional/promotional), RCS rich media messages, and emails with attachments. Deliver OTPs with automatic multi-channel fallback. Manage activities and tasks tied to CRM records. Retrieve campaign delivery reports across channels. Access workspace member information. Receive webhooks for incoming WhatsApp and RCS messages, SMS delivery reports, and CRM data changes.

Manage core Zoho workflows across CRM, Desk, Books, People, and Projects. Retrieve, search, create, update, delete, and inspect related CRM records. Manage Desk tickets and contacts. Work with Books organizations, invoices, contacts, and expenses. List People forms and manage form/employee, leave, and attendance data. Discover Projects portals and manage projects, tasks, and milestones.
skills: discover Zoho organization and portal IDs
subscribe to CRM and Desk event webhooks

integrations.description: Manage contacts, companies, deals, products, and activities in a lightweight CRM for small businesses. Create, read, update, delete, and search records across all modules. Manage related records, notes, and file attachments. Tag records, perform bulk read/write operations, and retrieve CRM metadata including fields, layouts, and custom views. Manage users, roles, and organization details. Subscribe to webhook notifications for real-time updates on record changes.

Manage small and medium business accounting including invoicing, expense tracking, payments, and financial reporting. Create and send invoices, estimates, sales orders, purchase orders, and bills with full lifecycle management. Record customer and vendor payments, issue credit notes and vendor credits, and process refunds. Track expenses with receipt attachments and manage recurring expenses. Manage contacts (customers and vendors) with billing/shipping addresses and payment terms. Handle banking operations including bank statement imports, transaction categorization, and matching. Manage chart of accounts, journal entries, fixed assets, inventory items, taxes, and multi-currency exchange rates. Create and track projects with tasks, time entries, and billing. Configure organization settings, users, roles, and reporting tags. Attach documents to transactions and send emails with customizable templates. Receive webhook notifications for events on invoices, contacts, expenses, bills, payments, and other modules.

Manage Zoho CRM records across standard and custom modules with the current V8 APIs. Create, read, update, delete, search, and query records; discover module fields, layouts, custom views, and related lists; manage notes, tags, and record attachments; send CRM emails; inspect users and organization metadata; and subscribe to record change notifications.

Manage customer support tickets, contacts, accounts, and knowledge base articles. Create, update, search, and delete support tickets with custom fields, priorities, statuses, and assignments. Handle ticket threads (email conversations), comments, attachments, and approvals. Manage customer contacts and company accounts with associated activities. Create and organize knowledge base articles with categories, translations, and versioning. Track agent availability and channel preferences. Log time entries against tickets and tasks with cost tracking. Manage tasks, calls, and calendar events tied to support operations. Configure departments for ticket routing and agent assignments. Search across tickets, contacts, accounts, and other modules. Receive real-time webhook notifications for changes to tickets, contacts, accounts, agents, articles, tasks, calls, time entries, and instant messaging sessions.

Manage inventory, orders, and invoicing across multiple warehouses. Create and track items, item groups, and composite items with SKU, pricing, and reorder levels. Create and manage sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, bills, and credit notes with full lifecycle support. Record inventory adjustments, transfer stock between warehouses, and manage packaging and shipments with tracking. Handle customer payments, sales returns, vendor credits, and refunds. Manage contacts, price lists, taxes, currencies, and users. Supports multi-warehouse operations, drop shipment workflows, and workflow-based webhook notifications.

Create, send, and manage invoices, estimates, credit notes, and recurring invoices for customers. Record customer payments, apply credits, and process refunds. Track expenses (billable and non-billable) and manage expense categories. Create and manage projects with tasks, user assignments, and time tracking with start/stop timers. Manage a catalog of items, price lists, tax rates, and multi-currency exchange rates. Handle customer and contact management with billing/shipping addresses and portal access. Send invoices and estimates via email individually or in bulk. Supports GST, VAT, and regional tax treatments across multiple Zoho data center regions.

Send, receive, search, and manage email messages, threads, folders, labels, and signatures. Schedule emails, manage drafts, flag and archive messages, and apply labels. Create and manage tasks with priorities, due dates, reminders, subtasks, and recurring schedules. Create and organize notes into books with attachments. Manage bookmarks in collections. Administer organizations, domains, users, groups, mail policies, and anti-spam settings. Configure email forwarding, vacation replies, domain DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM), and user protocol access (IMAP, POP, ActiveSync). Retrieve audit logs, login history, and SMTP logs. Receive webhooks for incoming emails, new tasks, and Streams posts.

Create, schedule, and manage video meetings and webinars. Manage users, roles, and account settings. Access and download cloud recordings and transcripts. Send and manage chat messages and channels. Handle Zoom Phone call logs, voicemails, and SMS. Manage meeting registrants, polls, and breakout rooms. Retrieve usage reports, meeting participant reports, and dashboard analytics. Configure Zoom Rooms and contact center settings. Receive real-time webhook notifications for meeting, webinar, recording, user, phone, and chat events.

Search and enrich B2B contact and company data from ZoomInfo's database of over 200 million business profiles. Look up contacts by title, company, location, and other filters. Enrich records with direct dials, email addresses, job titles, firmographics, technographics, corporate hierarchy, and funding details. Access intent data to identify accounts actively researching relevant topics. Retrieve actionable scoops and news about companies. Resolve anonymous website visitors to company-level data via WebSights. Manage data privacy compliance for GDPR and CCPA. Perform bulk search and enrichment operations at scale. Track credit and API usage. Receive real-time webhook notifications when previously enriched contact or company records change.

Send, retrieve, edit, and delete messages in channels (streams) and direct messages. Manage channels, topics, and user subscriptions. Search and filter messages using narrow queries. Add emoji reactions, upload file attachments, and manage message flags (read, starred). Create and manage channels with public/private visibility, subscribe/unsubscribe users, and configure per-channel notification settings. Retrieve and manage users, user groups, presence status, and typing indicators. Configure organization settings including custom emoji, linkifiers, and custom profile fields. Send invitations, manage drafts and saved snippets, and schedule messages for future delivery. Register for real-time events via long-polling to receive updates on new messages, reactions, presence changes, channel updates, and user activity.

Manage digital product sales, checkout flows, and subscriptions for creators and small businesses. Create, update, and delete products with configurable pricing models (one-time, subscription, delayed payments). Manage discount coupons with percentage or fixed-amount types, usage limits, and product scoping. Verify, redeem, and refund software license keys. Verify subscription status by subscriber email. Track sales events, new leads, affiliate sign-ups, and subscription lifecycle changes via webhooks.

Fetch and extract web content from any website with automatic anti-bot bypassing. Perform raw HTTP requests or browser-rendered requests that execute JavaScript. Use AI-powered extraction to get structured data such as products, articles, job postings, and forum threads. Capture screenshots, execute browser actions (scroll, click, type, wait, run JavaScript), manage sessions and cookies, and configure geolocation and IP type. Monitor API usage via a stats endpoint. Supports proxy mode for integration with existing HTTP tools.
